feature-ad-free-blurb: Free accounts are paid for by ads. A membership removes them everywhere — and the ad script is never even fetched, so nothing is loaded to be blocked.
feature-api-access-blurb: Programmatic access to the platform, with webhooks and image upload.
feature-bulk-content-blurb: Clean up thousands of posts, follows or bookmarks in one pass, with a preview before anything happens.
feature-custom-emoji-blurb: Upload your own emoji and use them anywhere on the site — posts, comments, messages and reactions.
feature-ladder-ai-prep-blurb: Turn any tracked application into a prep sheet: likely questions, your own stories matched to the posting.
feature-profile-badge-blurb: A badge on your profile and beside your name.
feature-speedrun-submit-blurb: Submit verified runs to per-category leaderboards. Free for everyone.
feature-sticker-packs-blurb: Build packs of your own stickers and emoji and publish them. Anyone can subscribe to your packs and use them — free accounts included.
feature-trash-extended-blurb: Deleted posts are recoverable for 30 days on a free account, and 90 days with a membership.
feature-typing-analytics-blurb: A per-key heatmap of your speed and accuracy, and practice runs generated from your own worst keys.
feature-voice-messages-blurb: Everyone gets voice messages. Members get longer ones at better quality — up to 10 minutes.

welcome-body: Игры, приложения и социальная лента — всё в одном месте. Вот несколько вещей, которые стоит попробовать.
whatsnew-membership-copy: The store now lists every feature a membership unlocks, and what each tier includes.
whatsnew-subtitle-calls: Voice calls between any two people, lighter and more private uploads, and thirteen more corners of the site in your own language.
whatsnew-translations-copy: Thirteen parts of the site — tournaments, wagers, saves, lists, awards and more — were only ever showing English. They speak all sixteen languages now.
whatsnew-upload-privacy-copy: Every image you upload is now losslessly re-compressed, and the location your camera quietly attached is stripped before anyone else can read it.
whatsnew-voice-calls-copy: Voice calls, straight from a conversation or someone’s profile. Audio goes directly between the two of you — it never passes through us.
